articles.abstract_en: We develop and calibrate a life-cycle model of labor supply and consumption to quantify the implications of alternative pension reforms on labor supply, individual welfare, and government budget for Chinas basic old-age insurance program. We distinguish low-skilled and high-skilled individuals, who differ in their preferences, health and labor income dynamics, and medical expense processes. We use the calibrated model to evaluate three potential pension reforms: (i) increasing the pension eligibility age from 60 to 65, but keeping the current pension benefit formula unchanged; (ii) keeping the pension eligibility age at 60, but proportionally lowering pension benefits so that the pension program’s budget is the same as under Reform (i); and (iii) increasing the pension eligibility age to 65 and simultaneously increasing the pension benefits so that individuals of both skill types attain the same individual welfare levels as in the status quo. We find that relative to the baseline, both Reforms (i) and (ii) can substantially improve the budgets of the pension system, but at the cost of substantial individual welfare loss for both skill types. In contrast, we find that Reform (iii) can modestly improve the budget of the pension system while ensuring that both skill types are as well off as in the status quo. We find that Reforms (i) and (ii) slightly increase, but Reform (iii) slightly decreases, the overall labor supply.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并校准了一个劳动力供给和消费的生命周期模型，以量化替代性养老金改革对中国基本养老保险计划中劳动力供给、个人福利和政府预算的影响。我们区分了低技能和高技能个体，他们在偏好、健康和劳动收入动态以及医疗支出过程方面存在差异。我们使用校准模型评估三种潜在的养老金改革：（i）将养老金领取资格年龄从60岁提高到65岁，但保持现行养老金待遇公式不变；（ii）将养老金领取资格年龄保持在60岁，但按比例降低养老金待遇，使养老金计划的预算与改革（i）下的预算相同；（iii）将养老金领取资格年龄提高到65岁，同时增加养老金待遇，使两种技能类型的个体都达到与现状相同的个人福利水平。我们发现，相对于基准情况，改革（i）和（ii）都能显著改善养老金体系的预算，但以两种技能类型个体的大量福利损失为代价。相比之下，我们发现改革（iii）可以适度改善养老金体系的预算，同时确保两种技能类型的福利水平与现状相同。我们发现改革（i）和（ii）略微增加了总体劳动力供给，而改革（iii）略微减少了总体劳动力供给。

articles.title_en: Central bank communication and website characteristics
articles.title_cn: 中央银行沟通与网站特征
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the characteristics of central bank websites across a large sample of central banks. We systematically derive and quantify these characteristics across three dimensions: text, visual presentation, and website performance. We then conduct a survey to isolate the main determinants of user experience. We find that websites with higher visual complexity and lower visual contrast are perceived as more clear and credible. We build a set of time series metrics based on historical website data to capture the evolution of central bank websites with respect to clarity, attractiveness, ease of navigation, and credibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了大量中央银行样本中中央银行网站的特征。我们系统地推导并量化了这些特征在三个维度上的表现：文本、视觉呈现和网站性能。随后，我们进行了一项调查，以隔离用户体验的主要决定因素。我们发现，视觉复杂度较高且视觉对比度较低的网站被认为更清晰、更可信。我们基于历史网站数据构建了一套时间序列指标，以捕捉中央银行网站在清晰度、吸引力、导航便捷性和可信度方面的演变。

articles.title_en: What we tweet about when we tweet about taxes: A topic modelling approach
articles.title_cn: 当我们谈论税收时我们在推特上谈论什么：一种主题建模方法
articles.abstract_en: Recent literature on taxation suggests that a “service and client” approach by the authorities is required in order to establish a synergistic tax climate between taxpayers and tax offices and thus enhance voluntary tax compliance. The present study investigates whether lay people's conceptions about taxation reflect such a synergistic (vs. an antagonistic) climate. Applying an unsupervised machine learning approach (i.e., topic modeling) to over a million tax related tweets from 2010 to 2020, we identified 30 topics with different content. Using the theoretical framework differentiating between synergistic and antagonistic tax climate, we were able to further categorize these topics into four broader groups: 1. Opinions about Tax Politics, 2. Enforcement (antagonistic climate), 3. Information & Service (synergistic climate), and 4. Emotions. The most frequently observed group was Information & Service (synergistic climate), which also steadily gained prominence during the past decade. We proceeded by analyzing the information diffusion properties and sentiment of the tweets associated with the four groups. Information & Service tweets had the most positive sentiment but were shared the least, while tweets regarding Opinions about Tax Politics were shared most often. In sum, the results suggest that lay people's conceptions about taxation – as discerned from conversations on social media (Twitter) – largely reflect a synergistic (vs. an antagonistic) climate, and contribute to the literature on tax climate and social media.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期关于税收的文献表明，税务机关需要采取“服务与客户”的方法，以在纳税人与税务机关之间建立协同的税收氛围，从而增强自愿税收遵从。本研究调查了外行人对税收的观念是否反映了这种协同（相对于对抗）氛围。应用无监督机器学习方法（即主题建模）对2010年至2020年间超过一百万条与税收相关的推文进行分析，我们识别出30个不同内容的主题。利用区分协同与对抗税收氛围的理论框架，我们进一步将这些主题归类为四个更广泛的组别：1. 关于税收政治的观点，2. 执法（对抗氛围），3. 信息与服务（协同氛围），以及4. 情绪。最常观察到的组别是信息与服务（协同氛围），并且在过去十年中其重要性稳步上升。我们接着分析了与这四个组别相关的推文的信息扩散特性和情感。信息与服务的推文情感最为积极，但分享最少，而关于税收政治观点的推文分享最多。总之，结果表明，外行人对税收的观念——从社交媒体（推特）上的对话中可以看出——在很大程度上反映了协同（相对于对抗）氛围，并为税收氛围和社交媒体的文献做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Overexertion of Effort under Working Time Autonomy and Feedback Provision
articles.title_cn: 工作时间自主性与反馈提供下的过度努力
articles.abstract_en: Working time autonomy is often accompanied by output-based incentives to counterbalance the loss of monitoring that comes with granting autonomy. However, in such settings, overprovision of effort could arise if workers are uncertain whether their performance suffices to secure the output-based rewards. Performance feedback can reduce or eliminate such uncertainty. We demonstrate in a laboratory experiment that a precautionary effort motive can lead to overprovision of costly effort in work environments with working time autonomy in the absence of feedback. A key feature of our design is that it allows for a clean measurement of effort overprovision by keeping performance per unit of time fixed, which we achieve by calibrating subjects’ productivity on a real effort task ex ante. This novel design can serve as a workhorse for various experiments as it allows for exogenous variation of performance certainty (i.e., by providing feedback), working time autonomy, productivity, effort costs, and the general incentive structure. We find that subjects provide significantly more costly effort beyond a level necessary to meet their performance targets in the presence of uncertainty, i.e., the absence of feedback, which suggests that feedback shields workers from overprovision of costly effort.
articles.abstract_cn: 工作时间自主性通常伴随着基于产出的激励，以抵消因授予自主权而带来的监督损失。然而，在这种情境下，如果工人不确定其绩效是否足以确保获得基于产出的奖励，就可能出现过度提供努力的情况。绩效反馈可以减少或消除这种不确定性。我们在实验室实验中证明，在没有反馈的工作时间自主性工作环境中，预防性努力动机可能导致过度提供昂贵努力。我们设计的一个关键特征是，通过事先校准受试者在真实努力任务上的生产率，保持单位时间绩效固定，从而能够干净地测量过度努力。这种新颖的设计可以作为各种实验的工作母机，因为它允许对绩效确定性（即通过提供反馈）、工作时间自主性、生产率、努力成本和一般激励结构进行外生变化。我们发现，在存在不确定性（即缺乏反馈）的情况下，受试者提供的昂贵努力显著超过达到其绩效目标所需的水平，这表明反馈保护工人免受过度提供昂贵努力的影响。

articles.title_en: Conformity and adaptation in groups
articles.title_cn: 群体中的从众与适应
articles.abstract_en: Empirical and experimental evidence suggests that individual behavior in group interactions is affected by perceived norms of behavior within the group. We design an experiment to test this hypothesis. We find that (a) when agents interact within a group, the initial diverse behaviors converge to the group average and individuals cluster more tightly around this benchmark as they learn the average, (b) actions further from this benchmark in a self-serving direction are less acceptable by others, and (c) when an agent is moved to a group with a different benchmark, s/he conforms quickly to the new benchmark.
articles.abstract_cn: 实证和实验证据表明，群体互动中个体行为受到群体内感知行为规范的影响。我们设计了一个实验来检验这一假设。我们发现：（a）当个体在群体内互动时，初始的多样化行为趋同于群体平均值，并且随着个体了解平均值，他们更紧密地聚集在该基准周围；（b）在利己方向上偏离该基准更远的行动更不被他人接受；（c）当个体被转移到具有不同基准的群体时，他/她会迅速适应新基准。

articles.title_en: Money supply, opinion dispersion, and stock prices
articles.title_cn: 货币供应、意见分歧与股票价格
articles.abstract_en: This study develops a simple model that shows how money matters in the determination of stock prices. When investors have different opinions on the stock's value and face market frictions, the money supply in an economy influences the demand for stocks and hence positively affects stock prices. Unlike the discounted-cash-flow model, the present model indicates that stock prices routinely depart from the fundamentals; overpricing or underpricing occurs depending on the amount of money in the economy. The results of the model suggest that stock prices fluctuate because of money supply changes and that monetary policy may cause a disconnect between the stock market and the real economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究构建了一个简单模型，用以说明货币在股票价格决定中的作用。当投资者对股票价值持有不同意见并面临市场摩擦时，经济中的货币供应会影响对股票的需求，从而对股票价格产生正向影响。与贴现现金流模型不同，本模型表明股票价格经常偏离基本面；高估或低估取决于经济中的货币量。模型结果表明，股票价格因货币供应变化而波动，货币政策可能导致股票市场与实体经济脱节。
